invariants.rationale: The method sets the passed-in HoodieWriteMetadata's write statuses to the returned list, so upon exit, result.getWriteStatuses() should be the same object as the return value.
The result parameter is not modified to null throughout the method body, so it must remain non-null at exit.
No code indicates writeStatuses may be set to null in the method, and it is assumed to be a required input.
The method always sets the index update duration on result to a non-null Duration before returning.
The method sets the write statuses of result to the returned List<WriteStatus>, which is the same as the result value at method exit.
